**8. Energy Trend?**

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**

Major divergence across core growth ETFs (SPY RECOVERY 1W:+0.54% | 1M:-1.80%; QQQ RECOVERY 1W:+0.60% | 1M:-4.09%; XLK RECOVERY 1W:+2.64% | 1M:-4.96%) suppresses a unilateral risk-on call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**12. Commodities to Watch?**

**13. Key Levels?**

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Energy and materials showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.39% | 1M: +14.85%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +8.41%)) while bonds remain in demand (TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +1.99%)). Key risk is rising volatility (VIX ↑ rising (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +6.12%) ABOVE TREND) and the SPY/QQQ/XLK 1W vs 1M divergence — monitor tech momentum and credit signals.
